newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Yukong Gas, seven others apply for IPOs.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Yukong Gas, seven others apply for IPOs.

text.p: Yukong Gas Co, a liquefied petroleum gas sales unit of Yukong Ltd, and seven other South Korean firms have applied for initial public offerings (IPOs), the Securities Supervisory Board said on Tuesday.
The other seven are Daou Technology Inc, LG-Caltex Gas Co Ltd, Yoo Sung Metal Co Ltd, Daewon Sanup Co Ltd, Pantech Co Ltd, Younbo Chemical Co Ltd and Poong Sung Electric Co Ltd.
An official at the board said the offerings were expected to be made between late June and early July, with the listing of shares on the Seoul stock market in July.
Yukong Gas, 56 percent owned by Yukong Ltd, would offer 2.4 million shares at 15,500 won per share, the board said.
Daou Technology, a computer software developer, would offer 480,000 shares at 50,000 won per share, the board said.
LG-Caltex Gas, a liquefied petroleum gas sales unit of the won per share.
Yoo Sung Metal, a maker of bolts, nuts and other metallic products, would offer 273,000 shares at 10,000 won each.
Daewon Sanup, an automobile seat maker, would offer 340,000 shares at 11,000 won per share.
Pantech, a telecommunications equipment maker, would offer 440,000 shares at 60,000 won each.
Younbo Chemical, a petrochemicals maker, would offer 290,400 shares at 31,000 won per share.
Poong Sung, an automobile parts maker, would offer 860,000 shares at 19,000 won per share.
